title: Debt and Contact
author: Sable Crane
blurb: Lena Reyes, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
